fieldNotes.truckGate: No barrier arm, sliding gate, or guard booth could be positively identified at any vehicular entrance in z18-z21 satellite or in multiple Street View passes along the entire E Valley Rd south frontage. The frontage is a continuous landscaped lawn/tree buffer with paved driveway breaks (office/visitor entry on the SE) and the truck yard accessed via open internal drives. Per the rubric (open driveway with no visible control = false) classified false, but flagged uncertain: a 1.5M sqft secured Target RDC plausibly has an internal/manned truck checkpoint not resolvable from this imagery.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No small multi-window booth (1-3 vehicle footprint) found beside any lane in any high-zoom crop.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Central cross-dock bank shows two long rows of trailers backed in on both faces plus a dock row on the east building face; well over 50 doors. dockDoorCount=120 is an estimate from the cross-dock + east-face rhythm.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Large dedicated trailer-storage lot on the east/SE holds hundreds of trailers in dense rows (z18 east-entrance crop). 50+ band, dropYard=true.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Cross-dock layout with trailer banks on opposing N and S faces of the central dock plus an east-face dock suggests separate inbound/outbound clusters; inferred, flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide open paved yard aprons at the entrances leave ample room to add an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town Oconomowoc (Pabst Farms) industrial setting bordered by farmland and a lake to the SW; classified Rural per rubric's small-town guidance, though served by a developed commercial/industrial corridor so cellular connectivity is fine.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Derived from perimeter polygon (~500m N-S x ~430m E-W), approx 53 acres.
